name: Typeform
description: Typeform lets agents create and edit forms, and read and analyze form responses in the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own Typeform account through the browser.

prompts.text: Summarize the responses to the customer feedback form from this month.
Draft a five-question event registration form.
Which respondents gave a score below 6, and what did they say?

apps.name: Typeform
apps.description: Form creation and response analysis, over Typeform's MCP server with browser sign-in.
